resources.string: View battery readings reported by Android.
Android reports no battery present. No battery readings are shown.

Values are device-reported, not calibrated. Current sign and property availability depend on the device; readings update with system battery broadcasts, not continuously. The charge counter is not design capacity. System health status is not a battery capacity or degradation percentage. No remaining-time or health-percentage estimates are made.
Readings are shown only while this screen is active and cleared on leaving. No permissions, saved measurements, network access, or sharing.
Open the tool to view supported battery properties while this screen is active. Unknown means Android did not provide a supported value.
Connect or disconnect a charger and wait for Android to report the changed power source.
Not a calibrated diagnostic or capacity test. Reported health is a system status, not health percentage. No remaining-time estimate.
